subject: Cloud marketplace access checklist & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud marketplace access checklist & procurement next steps

Hi Lena — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on procurement and the right commercial path.

Call recap (high level):
- Novus Health wants low-friction procurement for a POC: preference for AWS Marketplace if it supports metered billing + SSO; fallback to standard PO if Marketplace not available in time.
- Procurement timeline target: 4–6 weeks for enterprise onboarding (we discussed prioritizing the POC).
- Security: you asked about SOC 2 and data handling — we can provide the latest attestation and a short security appendix.

Action items / questions from our side:
1) Can you confirm procurement contact(s) (name + email) so we can share the vendor registration form?
2) Confirm whether Novus requires the invoice to be addressed to a purchasing org (or centralized AP email) when using PO.
3) Is Novus ok with us initiating the AWS Marketplace onboarding in parallel while procurement evaluates the PO path? (Marketplace often shortens billing lead time.)

Attachments: I’ve included a one-page Mutual Action Plan and our vendor_registration_form (PDF stub) for procurement.

Proposed next step: 15–20 minute intro between procurement + our onboarding lead early next week (I’m available Tue/Wed morning PT). If that works, I’ll loop in our Marketplace / Channel manager and Legal for the procurement checklist items.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Novus_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet) | vendor_registration_form.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
From: Lena Park <lena.park@novushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace access checklist & procurement next steps

Hi Karthik — thanks for the summary and for sending the MAP.

A few clarifications from procurement side (high level):
- Procurement preference: we prefer AWS Marketplace if the listing supports metered usage and integrates with our SSO (Okta). If that is a blocker, we will proceed with a PO.
- Timeline: procurement will review vendor forms and compliance docs; expect a 3–5 week review for standard vendors, 5–7 weeks if legal/redlines are required. We can accelerate for a POC with a limited-scope order.
- Invoices/PO: yes, please address invoices to Novus Health AP (ap@novushealth.com) and include our PO number on the invoice.

We attached the vendor_registration_form we received from our vendor portal (I’m including it here for clarity). Please also send the vendor onboarding checklist you mentioned.

Two asks for you:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood’s AWS Marketplace listing will support metered billing (per-token or per-hour) or will it be a subscription seat/license model?
2) Please share SOC 2 type II report or a pointer to where procurement can download it.

If you want, feel free to schedule a short call with procurement next Tue (Apr 13) between 10–12 PT; otherwise we’ll review the docs and follow up.

Lena Park
Head of Cloud Procurement
Novus Health
lena.park@novushealth.com | +1 617-555-4412

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace access checklist & procurement next steps

Hi Lena — Jordan here (Channel Partnerships). Thanks for the clear notes. Quick answers and proposed path: 

1) Marketplace model: our AWS Marketplace onboarding is in progress. For GA we support both subscription (fixed price) and metered listings for usage-based billing. For your POC we can request a metered SKU (per-1K tokens equivalent) and confirm the precise meter with Product/BI.

2) SOC2: we’ll share the latest SOC 2 Type II report via a secure link; I’ve added our Security contact to the thread (Marissa) for any additional evidence.

Proposed procurement path (to keep both options open):
- Step A (parallel): We initiate Marketplace onboarding today so listing & SKU creation are in motion (this typically takes 2–4 weeks depending on Marketplace review).
- Step B (PO fallback): We’ll provide a DocuSign-ready Order Form + standard SOW you can sign with a PO number. If the Marketplace listing is delayed, procurement can use the PO route to keep the POC timeline.
- Step C (legal): If Novus needs MSA edits, please return redlines to legal@novushealth.com and cc marissa_cole@redwood.ai; we can prioritize a limited-scope appendix for the POC to reduce review time.

Attachments: I’m re-attaching a short Marketplace Onboarding Checklist and the Mutual Action Plan with proposed milestones.

Next steps from us: with your go-ahead we’ll: 1) upload the vendor_registration_form to our onboarding portal, 2) share the secure SOC2 link, 3) provision a marketplace draft SKU and share ETA.

Would you like me to include our Legal (emma.landry@redwood.ai) and Channel Ops (michael_chan@redwood.ai) on the next procurement call?

Thanks — Jordan
Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
